title: Count all vertices
script: g.v().count()

title: Names of people
script: g.v().has_label("person").values("name")

title: People older than 30 (camelCase spelling)
script: g.V().hasLabel("person").has("age", P.gt(30)).valueMap(true)

title: Who does marko know?
script: g.v(1).out("knows").values("name")

title: Element maps of all edges
script: g.e().element_map()

title: Count by label
script: g.v().group_count().by(T.label)

title: Software and its creators
script:
g.v().has_label("software").project("name", "creators")
  .by("name")
  .by(__.in_("created").values("name").fold())

title: Paths of length 2
script: g.v(1).out().out().path()

title: Two hops with repeat()
script: g.v(1).repeat(__.out()).times(2).values("name")

title: People ordered by age
script:
g.v().has_label("person").order().by("age", Order.desc)
  .project("name", "age").by("name").by("age")

title: Add a vertex
script: g.add_v("person").property("name", "zoe").property("age", 23)

title: Rhai program: build a service inventory (functions, loops, nested objects)
Rhai variables: compute over query results
Whom does each person know? (GQL)
script: g.gql("MATCH (p:person)-[:knows]->(f:person) RETURN p.name AS who, f.name AS friend, f.age AS age ORDER BY age DESC")

title: Inline properties and an edge variable
script: g.gql("MATCH (a:person {name: 'marko'})-[e:knows]->(b) RETURN b.name AS friend, e.weight AS weight ORDER BY weight DESC")

title: A $parameter: creators of software in one language
script: g.gql("MATCH (p:person)-[:created]->(s:software) WHERE s.lang = $lang RETURN p.name AS person, s.name AS project ORDER BY person", #{lang: "java"})

title: Multi-line query in a backtick string: co-creators
script:
// Backtick strings span lines; GQL strings use single quotes inside them.
g.gql(`
  MATCH (a:person)-[:created]->(s:software)<-[:created]-(b:person)
  WHERE a.name < b.name
  RETURN a.name AS one, b.name AS other, s.name AS project
  ORDER BY project, one, other
`)

title: Label expression and string predicates
script: g.gql("MATCH (v:person|software) WHERE v.name STARTS WITH 'j' OR v.name ENDS WITH 'p' RETURN v.name AS name, labels(v) AS labels ORDER BY name")

title: RETURN * with ORDER BY and LIMIT
script: g.gql("MATCH (p:person)-[:created]->(s:software) RETURN * ORDER BY p.name, s.name LIMIT 3")

title: Paging with OFFSET (SKIP) and LIMIT
script: g.gql("MATCH (p:person) RETURN p.name AS name, p.age AS age ORDER BY age OFFSET 1 LIMIT 2")

title: NULL for a missing property (NULLs sort last)
script: g.gql("MATCH (v) RETURN v.name AS name, v.age AS age ORDER BY age, name")

title: Either direction, with the edge label
script: g.gql("MATCH (x {name: 'josh'})-[e]-(y) RETURN type(e) AS rel, y.name AS other ORDER BY other")

title: Aggregates: count and collect_list per person (implicit grouping)
script:
// The columns without an aggregate (person) are the grouping key; GROUP BY is optional.
g.gql(`
  MATCH (p:person)-[:created]->(s:software)
  RETURN p.name AS person, count(s) AS projects, collect_list(s.name) AS names
  ORDER BY projects DESC, person
`)

title: Aggregates over all rows: count, sum, avg, min, max
script: g.gql("MATCH (p:person) RETURN count(*) AS people, sum(p.age) AS total, avg(p.age) AS mean, min(p.age) AS youngest, max(p.age) AS oldest")

title: count(DISTINCT ...): creators per language
script: g.gql("MATCH (s:software)<-[:created]-(p:person) RETURN s.lang AS lang, count(s) AS rows, count(DISTINCT p) AS creators ORDER BY lang")

title: round(avg(...), 1) with GROUP BY
script:
// GROUP BY lists the non-aggregated RETURN items; without it the grouping is the same.
g.gql(`
  MATCH (p:person)-[e:created]->(s:software)
  RETURN p.name AS person, round(avg(e.weight), 1) AS mean_weight, count(s) AS projects
  GROUP BY person
  ORDER BY person
`)

title: WITH: aggregate, then filter on the aggregate
script:
g.gql(`
  MATCH (p:person)-[:knows]->(f:person)
  WITH p, count(f) AS friends, avg(f.age) AS mean_age
  WHERE friends >= 2
  RETURN p.name AS person, friends, mean_age
  ORDER BY person
`)

title: WITH ... ORDER BY ... LIMIT, then MATCH again: the two oldest and their projects
script:
g.gql(`
  MATCH (p:person)
  WITH p ORDER BY p.age DESC LIMIT 2
  MATCH (p)-[:created]->(s:software)
  RETURN p.name AS person, s.name AS project
  ORDER BY person, project
`)

title: OPTIONAL MATCH: NULL when nothing matches
script:
g.gql(`
  MATCH (p:person)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:created]->(s:software)
  RETURN p.name AS person, s.name AS project
  ORDER BY person, project
`)

title: OPTIONAL MATCH with count: zero for the unmatched
script:
g.gql(`
  MATCH (p:person)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:created]->(s)
  RETURN p.name AS person, count(s) AS projects
  ORDER BY projects DESC, person
`)

title: LET and FILTER with a $parameter
script:
g.gql(`
  MATCH (p:person)
  LET decade = p.age / 10 * 10
  FILTER decade >= $from
  RETURN p.name AS name, decade
  ORDER BY decade, name
`, #{from: 30})

title: FOR over a $parameter list: one row per item
script:
// FOR x IN list (Cypher UNWIND list AS x) gives one row per item; a name with no person gives no row.
g.gql(`
  FOR n IN $names
  MATCH (p:person {name: n})
  RETURN n AS name, p.age AS age
  ORDER BY name
`, #{names: ["vadas", "marko", "nobody"]})

title: FOR id IN $ids: vertices by element id
script:
// The element_id equality after FOR is a direct lookup by id (see .profile()), not a scan.
g.gql("FOR id IN $ids MATCH (n) WHERE element_id(n) = id RETURN id, n.name AS name ORDER BY name", #{ids: ["1", "3", "42"]})

title: UNWIND a collected list (Cypher spelling)
script:
g.gql(`
  MATCH (p:person)
  WITH collect_list(p.name) AS names
  UNWIND names AS name
  RETURN name
  ORDER BY name
`)

title: FOR ... WITH ORDINALITY: the item's position from 1
script:
// WITH ORDINALITY counts from 1, WITH OFFSET from 0.
g.gql("FOR x IN [10, 20, 30] WITH ORDINALITY i RETURN i, x, x * i AS weighted ORDER BY i")

title: RETURN without MATCH: one row of expressions
script:
// A query may start with FOR, UNWIND, LET, WITH, FILTER or RETURN: it runs on one empty row.
g.gql("RETURN 1 + 2 AS three, upper('gql') AS name, range(1, 3) AS list ORDER BY three")

title: Who has no ...? NOT EXISTS: people who created nothing
script:
// NOT EXISTS { pattern } keeps the rows the pattern does not match; the plan is v(labels: ["person"]).not(__.out("created")) (see .profile()).
g.gql("MATCH (p:person) WHERE NOT EXISTS { (p)-[:created]->() } RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name")

title: EXISTS { MATCH ... WHERE ... }: each java creator once
script:
// EXISTS tests a match and keeps the row once; MATCH (p)-[:created]->(s) would give one row per project.
g.gql(`
  MATCH (p:person)
  WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:created]->(s:software) WHERE s.lang = 'java' }
  RETURN p.name AS name
  ORDER BY name
`)

title: Cypher pattern predicate: people known by someone
script:
// A pattern where a condition stands is EXISTS { pattern }; it may name only variables bound before it.
g.gql("MATCH (p:person) WHERE ()-[:knows]->(p) RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name")

title: EXISTS in RETURN: a TRUE / FALSE column per row
script:
// EXISTS is TRUE or FALSE, never NULL, and stands anywhere an expression does.
g.gql(`
  MATCH (p:person)
  RETURN p.name AS name,
         EXISTS { (p)-[:knows]->() } AS knows_someone,
         (p)-[:created]->(:software {lang: 'java'}) AS creates_java
  ORDER BY name
`)

title: CALL { } per row: each person's heaviest software (top k per group)
OPTIONAL CALL with an aggregate: a count per row, 0 included
COUNT { } and COLLECT { }: related data per row
script:
// COUNT { } is the number of matches (never NULL); COLLECT { } the list of its one RETURN column.
g.gql(`
  MATCH (p:person)
  RETURN p.name AS who,
         COUNT { (p)-[:created]->() } AS projects,
         COLLECT { MATCH (p)-[:created]->(s) RETURN s.name ORDER BY s.name } AS names
  ORDER BY projects DESC, who
`)

title: UNION and NEXT: one name list from two labels, sorted
script:
// UNION removes duplicate rows (UNION ALL keeps them); NEXT sorts and cuts the whole union.
g.gql(`
  MATCH (p:person) WHERE p.age > 30 RETURN p.name AS name
  UNION
  MATCH (s:software) RETURN s.name AS name
  NEXT RETURN name ORDER BY name
`)

title: Map projection p {.name, .age, key: expr}: one map per person
script:
// A map projection builds a map from an element: .key reads a property, key: expr computes one, .* takes all.
g.gql("MATCH (p:person) RETURN p {.name, .age, decade: p.age / 10} AS person ORDER BY person.name")

title: Pattern comprehension: a JSON-shaped answer with nested lists
script:
// [(p)-[:knows]->(f) | f.name] is the list of the pattern's matches per row ([] when none, items in no defined order).
g.gql(`
  MATCH (p:person)
  RETURN p {.name,
            friends: [(p)-[:knows]->(f) | f.name],
            projects: [(p)-[:created]->(s) | s {.name, .lang}]} AS person
  ORDER BY person.name
`).to_json()

title: List comprehension [x IN list WHERE .. | ..]: the names along a path
script:
// WHERE keeps the items it is TRUE for, | maps each kept item; both parts are optional.
g.gql(`
  MATCH p = (a:person {name: 'marko'})-[:knows|created]->{1,2}(b)
  RETURN b.name AS reached,
         [x IN nodes(p) | x.name] AS names,
         [x IN nodes(p) WHERE x:software | x.name] AS programs
  ORDER BY size(names), reached
`)

title: size() of a pattern comprehension: people with two or more projects
script:
// size([pattern | x]) counts the matches per row; EXISTS is enough when only one match matters.
g.gql("MATCH (p:person) WHERE size([(p)-[:created]->(s) | s]) >= 2 RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name")

title: all() / any() and reduce(): list predicates and a fold per row
script:
// openCypher compatibility forms; all/any/none/single are three-valued (NULL items count).
g.gql(`
  MATCH (p:person)
  LET weights = [(p)-[e:created]->() | e.weight]
  RETURN p.name AS who,
         all(w IN weights WHERE w >= 0.4) AS all_heavy,
         any(w IN weights WHERE w = 1.0) AS one_full,
         reduce(total = 0, w IN weights | total + w) AS total
  ORDER BY who
`)

title: Quantified edges {1,2}: reachable in one or two hops
script: g.gql("MATCH (a:person {name: 'marko'})-[:knows|created]->{1,2}(b) RETURN DISTINCT b.name AS reached ORDER BY reached")

title: Cypher variable length [e*1..2]: the edge list e
script:
// [e*1..2] is GQL ->{1,2}; e is the list of the edges walked (Cypher's lower bound defaults to 1).
g.gql("MATCH (a:person {name: 'marko'})-[e*1..2]->(b) RETURN b.name AS reached, size(e) AS hops ORDER BY hops, reached")

title: Quantified path pattern ((x)-[e]->(y)){1,2}: group lists
script:
// A variable inside the group is the list of its nodes or edges, one per iteration; (a) is the
// first x and (b) the last y.
g.gql(`
  MATCH (a:person {name: 'marko'}) ((x)-[e:knows|created]->(y)){1,2} (b)
  RETURN b.name AS reached, [n IN y | n.name] AS via, size(e) AS hops
  ORDER BY hops, reached
`)

title: Quantified path pattern with a two-hop body: co-creators
script:
// The body repeats a whole chain: person -created-> software <-created- person, once or twice.
// Every edge is used at most once per match, so x and y of one iteration differ.
g.gql(`
  MATCH (a:person) ((x)-[:created]->(s)<-[:created]-(y)){1,2} (b)
  RETURN DISTINCT a.name AS person, b.name AS co_creator
  ORDER BY person, co_creator
`)

title: Body WHERE in a quantified path pattern: always to someone older
script:
// The body's WHERE is checked in every iteration and reads only the body's variables.
g.gql(`
  MATCH (a:person) ((x)-[:knows|created]-(y) WHERE y.age > x.age){1,3} (b)
  RETURN a.name AS younger, b.name AS older, size(y) AS steps
  ORDER BY younger, older
`)

title: Optional path pattern ((..))?: NULL when it matched nothing
script:
// With ? the body's variables are single values (ISO), NULL for the row where the part is
// skipped; then (q) is (p) itself.
g.gql(`
  MATCH (p:person) ((x)-[:created]->(s:software) WHERE s.lang = 'java')? (q)
  RETURN p.name AS who, s.name AS project, q.name AS last
  ORDER BY who, project
`)

title: Path variable p = ...: the path and its length
script:
g.gql(`
  MATCH p = (a:person {name: 'marko'})-[:knows]->{0,1}(b)-[:created]->(s:software)
  RETURN s.name AS project, path_length(p) AS len, p
  ORDER BY len, project, b.name
`)

title: nodes(p) and relationships(p) of a path
script:
g.gql(`
  MATCH p = (a:person {name: 'marko'})-[:knows|created]->{1,2}(b)
  RETURN b.name AS reached, size(relationships(p)) AS hops,
         head(nodes(p)).name AS first, last(nodes(p)).name AS last
  ORDER BY hops, reached
`)

title: Conversions: CAST (strict) and toInteger / toIntegerOrNull (lenient)
script:
// CAST fails the query on text that is not a value of the type; the Cypher conversions give NULL.
g.gql(`
  MATCH (p:person)
  RETURN p.name AS name, CAST(p.age AS STRING) AS age_text, toInteger('4' || '2') AS answer,
         toFloat(p.age) / 10 AS decades, toIntegerOrNull(p.name) AS not_a_number
  ORDER BY name
`)

title: String functions: substring, upper, split, replace
script:
g.gql(`
  MATCH (s:software)
  RETURN s.name AS name, upper(substring(s.name, 0, 1)) || substring(s.name, 1) AS title,
         split(s.name, 'p') AS pieces, replace(s.lang, 'java', 'JVM') AS platform
  ORDER BY name
`)

title: keys and properties of vertices and edges
script: g.gql("MATCH (a {name: 'marko'})-[e]->(b) RETURN b.name AS other, keys(e) AS edge_keys, properties(b) AS props ORDER BY other")

title: startNode and endNode: the stored direction of an edge
script:
// -[e]- matches either direction; startNode(e) / endNode(e) give the edge's own source and target.
g.gql("MATCH (x {name: 'josh'})-[e]-(y) RETURN y.name AS other, startNode(e).name AS source, endNode(e).name AS target ORDER BY other")

title: INSERT: new nodes and an edge to a matched node
INSERT ... RETURN: read what was just written
script:
// Variables of an INSERT are bound afterwards: RETURN reads the new elements.
g.gql("FOR name IN ['kiwi', 'plum'] INSERT (f:fruit {name: name, added: true}) RETURN f.name AS fruit, labels(f) AS labels ORDER BY fruit")

script:
g.v("root").glob_path("**/*.rs", #{prune: __.has("name", "author")})
  .by("name").by(["directory", "file"]).order().by(T.id).id()

  .execute(#{profile: true, profile_types: ["memory"]})
